name: Deadly Reunion
source:
A reunion party — a place filled with old memories shared among friends.
But what if, on that very night, all of your friends were murdered right before your eyes? What would you do?

Run away?
Find the killer?
Or die with them?

[From [url=https://nobii.itch.io/deadly-reunion]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
聚会——一个充满朋友之间分享的旧回忆的地方。
但如果就在那天晚上，你所有的朋友都在你眼前被谋杀了怎么办？你会怎么办？

逃跑？
找出凶手？
还是和他们一起死？

[来自[url=https://nobii.itch.io/deadly-reunion]itch.io[/url]]
